New SUV Models Set to Launch in India

Two new SUV models are slated for launch in India. Toyota is preparing to introduce the Fortuner Leader Edition in 2026. Additionally, the JSW Combat Plug-In Hybrid SUV is scheduled for its India debut on December 4, and is positioned to compete with the Toyota Fortuner.
